per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must respond to routine screen transitions and lookups within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be available during all operational hours, with planned maintenance windows limited to specific early morning hours.
The system must integrate with the corporate identity provider for internal reps, using SAML or OIDC, and use strong multi-factor authentication for external partners.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must enforce row-level security to ensure that reps can only access data for customers they are assigned to.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be horizontally scalable for web and API layers, with autoscaling workers and backpressure management.

The system must provide an immutable audit trail that records every meaningful user action, including who did something, when, which fields changed, what the previous values were, which external systems were called, the correlation IDs, and the outcome.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must avoid generating letters locally and instead rely on the Letters subsystem for all letter generation and formatting.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Letters application. This will allow the Disputes application to request letters as part of the dispute initiation and dispute follow up process. All letter requests must be sent to the Print Letter Utility application.'
